Stephanie — thanks for the draft. Quick reads and a small attachment with annotated metric notes.

- On Objective 2 (Improve inference economics): the suggested KPI "cost per 1k tokens" is okay but noisy across model families. Recommend we use: "Unit cost normalized to latency bucket" or explicitly include a P95 latency target as the quality guardrail.
- Suggest replacing the single combined velocity metric with two: 1) new customer time-to-first-inference (TTFI), 2) rollout success rate for Dedicated migrations.

I attached an Excel with inline comments: OKR-comments-aditya.xlsx

On the QBR slides: slide 7 (migration options) needs a one-liner on rollback SLAs — otherwise good.

Onwards,
Aditya
